description.zh-CN: Jsonita 产品、计划、规格、发布与工作流的重要变化记录。
description.en: Important Jsonita product, plan, spec, release, and workflow changes.

rows.zh-CN: 彻底重写 plan/spec 文档发布面：为 5 篇 plan 与 16 篇 spec 新增同名 CAST JSON 源，全部通过 cast-a-doc 渲染为中英双语 HTML，并新增 workflow.html 公开 .cast-docs 工作流。
rows.en: Thoroughly rewrote the plan/spec published surface: added same-name CAST JSON sources for 5 plan docs and 16 spec docs, rendered all of them with cast-a-doc into bilingual Chinese/English HTML, and added workflow.html to expose the .cast-docs workflow.

plan/*.json, plan/*.html, spec/*.json, spec/*.html, site/workflow.json, workflow.html, site/index.cast.json, site/todo.json, site/changelist.json, README.md, TODO.md, CHANGELIST.md, scripts/render_cast_docs.mjs, scripts/check_cast_docs.mjs.

rows.zh-CN: docs:check 现在逐页校验 CAST profile、render freshness、plan/spec JSON 源、双语 switcher、renderer-owned HTML 和 raw Mermaid/CDN 回归。
rows.en: docs:check now validates CAST profile, render freshness, plan/spec JSON sources, bilingual switchers, renderer-owned HTML, and raw Mermaid/CDN regressions page by page.

rows.zh-CN: 剩余开放项只保留真实未决问题：崩溃恢复/数据完整性、macOS vibrancy 真实环境验收、CI 接入和更大范围分发合规。
rows.en: Remaining open items only keep real unresolved work: crash recovery/data integrity, real macOS vibrancy verification, CI wiring, and broader-distribution compliance.

rows.zh-CN: 按最新版 cast-a-start 修复 Jsonita 文档结构：新增 .cast-docs/WORKFLOW.md，瘦身 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md，升级首页、TODO、CHANGELIST 为 CAST JSON-first 渲染面，并补充 docs:render / docs:check。
rows.en: Repaired the Jsonita documentation structure against the latest cast-a-start: added .cast-docs/WORKFLOW.md, thinned AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, upgraded homepage, TODO, and CHANGELIST to CAST JSON-first rendered surfaces, and added docs:render / docs:check.
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cast-docs/WORKFLOW.md, site/*.json, index.html, todo.html, changelist.html, scripts/*docs*.mjs, package.json, and plan/spec legacy diagram surfaces.

rows.zh-CN: 运行 CAST profile 校验、CAST JSON 渲染与 freshness 检查、本地链接检查、Mermaid/raw CDN 发布面检查和 git diff 空白检查。
rows.en: Run CAST profile validation, CAST JSON rendering and freshness checks, local link checks, Mermaid/raw CDN published-surface checks, and git diff whitespace checks.

rows.zh-CN: 本条为结构修复记录；后续全量 plan/spec 重写已在同日新增记录中完成。
rows.en: This row records the structure repair; full plan/spec rewrite is completed in the newer same-day changelist row.

rows.zh-CN: 用 cast-a-doc 重新生成双语文档首页。
rows.en: Regenerated the bilingual documentation homepage with cast-a-doc.

rows.zh-CN: 继续让首页源与渲染产物保持 freshness。
rows.en: Keep homepage source and rendered output fresh.

rows.zh-CN: README 与文档首页声明 CAST 写作约定。
rows.en: Declared the CAST writing contract in README and the documentation homepage.

rows.zh-CN: 需求、规格或实现变更继续同步 README、index、site JSON、plan 与 spec。
rows.en: Requirement, spec, or implementation changes should continue to sync README, index, site JSON, plan, and spec.

rows.zh-CN: 设计稿核心决策迁入 plan/spec，并补齐 CAST 文档源数据层。
rows.en: Migrated stable design decisions into plan/spec and added the CAST source-data layer.
plan/, spec/, site/todo.json, site/changelist.json, todo.html, changelist.html, and index.html.

rows.zh-CN: design/*.html 保留为历史探索材料，不再作为实现规格权威。
rows.en: design/*.html remains historical exploration material and is no longer implementation authority.
